# Thiago Pari

> M.S. Robotics, Northeastern University, graduating May 2027. Perception, 3D mapping and state estimation: underwater sonar and IMU mapping, structure-from-motion, sensor fusion. Open to full-time perception, 3D mapping, ROS 2 and research engineering roles after May 2027.

I work on perception and mapping for places where cameras and GPS stop being reliable. 2nd place ×2 in Oct 2026: Hackachusetts (Robotics track) and the Wajo AI × Anthropic Hackathon (Hyperion × Fo).

- Site: https://thiagopari.github.io/ThiagoPari/
- Resume (PDF): https://thiagopari.github.io/ThiagoPari/Pari%20Resume.pdf
- Email: parimaquera.t@northeastern.edu

## Experience

- Robotics Engineer Co-op, Underwater Perception & 3D Mapping, Archenaux Robotics (Somerville, MA, May – Sep 2026): owned the 3D mapping architecture for an underwater hull-inspection robot (sensor selection, ROS 2 sonar and IMU drivers, SLAM evaluation on pool data) and trained a real-time segmentation model. Under NDA; details are on the resume.

## Projects

- [Craigie Bridge Inspector](https://thiagopari.github.io/ThiagoPari/projects/craigie-bridge/): ArduPilot SITL drone inspection in Isaac Sim. 2nd in Robotics, Hackachusetts, Oct 2026.
- [Underwater SfM Degradation Study](https://thiagopari.github.io/ThiagoPari/projects/underwater-sfm/): physics-based underwater renderer feeding COLMAP, scored against a clear-air reference over 64 seeded runs; relocalizing into a map built once in clear water keeps the map in one piece where from-scratch SfM fragments (30/30 and 25/30 cameras against 17 and 16). Solo, Jul – Nov 2026.
- [LiDAR Odometry Under Degradation](https://thiagopari.github.io/ThiagoPari/projects/lidar-odometry/): KISS-ICP, GICP and map-based VGICP on real KITTI scans under fewer beams, dropout, range noise, shorter range and lower scan rates. Solo, in progress.
- [Learner's Permit](https://thiagopari.github.io/ThiagoPari/projects/learners-permit/): licences for robot skills, enforced with Cedar. Nebius × NVIDIA Global AI Hackathon, Oct 2026.
- [Bayesian Skill Gate for VLA Robot Policies](https://thiagopari.github.io/ThiagoPari/projects/skill-gate/): an AI agent may trigger a robot skill only after trials show P(success ≥ 0.8) ≥ 0.95 under a Beta posterior; GR00T N1.7 in LIBERO on a Dell GB10. Team of 4.
- [Mission Preflight](https://thiagopari.github.io/ThiagoPari/projects/mission-preflight/): sandboxed checks for ROV missions in Kata microVMs. Vultr Agent Rush, Nov 2026. Solo.
- [Hyperion × Fo](https://thiagopari.github.io/ThiagoPari/projects/hyperion-fo/): technician dispatch for robot faults. 2nd place, Wajo AI × Anthropic Hackathon, Oct 2026.
- [Multi-Sensor Fusion Localization](https://thiagopari.github.io/ThiagoPari/projects/ekf-localization/): 50 Hz ROS 2 EKF and UKF fusing wheel odometry, IMU and simulated GPS in Gazebo; ported to C++ (rclcpp + Eigen) with gtest and CI. Solo.
- Robustness Analysis of Convex Bundle Adjustment: EECE 5550 course project, team of 2. Stress-tested XM, a convex SDP bundle-adjustment pipeline, under severe image blur and ill-conditioned problems.
- [12-DOF Quadruped Robot](https://thiagopari.github.io/ThiagoPari/projects/quadruped/): printed, wired and calibrated 12-servo quadruped based on Will Cogley's RoboFox design; MuJoCo IK and gait, an Isaac Lab model of the leg mechanism, and a sim-first VIO study with OpenVINS.
- [Pierside](https://thiagopari.github.io/ThiagoPari/projects/pierside/): book an underwater inspection in one conversation. PayPal AI Hackathon, Nov 2026.
- [Mandate Wallet](https://thiagopari.github.io/ThiagoPari/projects/mandate-wallet/): signed spending limits for AI agents. PayPal AI Hackathon, Nov 2026.

- Robotics & Simulation: ROS 2 (rosbag2, DDS, TF, MAVROS), Isaac Sim / Replicator, Gazebo, MuJoCo; sonar, IMU, GPS, cameras
- Programming & Tools: Python, C++, MATLAB, SQL, Git, Linux, Docker, pytest, GitHub Actions CI, Claude Code
